import json, urllib.request, time
def get(url):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        return r.read()
base = "https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/mteb/results/commits/main?limit=100"

cursor = None
for page in range(60):
    url = base + (f"&cursor={cursor}" if cursor else "")
    data = json.loads(get(url))
    if isinstance(data, dict):  # pagination format
        commits = data.get('commits', [])
        cursor = data.get('cursor') or data.get('nextCursor')
    else:
        commits = data
        cursor = None
    all_commits.extend(commits)
    print(f"page {page}: +{len(commits)} total={len(all_commits)} oldest={commits[-1].get('date') if commits else '?'}", flush=True)
    if not cursor or not commits:
        break
    if commits and commits[-1].get('date','') < '2025-07-25':
        break
    time.sleep(0.3)
json.dump(all_commits, open('/tmp/results_commits.json','w'))
print("saved", len(all_commits))
EOF
